subject.title: build: unify Makefile targets across crawler repos

question: Should the shared Makefile contract preserve bare `make` as a CLI build, or intentionally migrate it to help output with an explicit compatibility decision?
rationale: The branch deliberately introduces a new default target, but existing undocumented local automation may depend on the current build default; this is a product and compatibility choice rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Preserve bare build behavior
options.body: Remove the `help` default so bare `make` continues to build the CLI while contributors can use `make help` explicitly.

options.title: Adopt help as the default
options.body: Keep the new default only with maintainer-visible confirmation that existing bare-`make` automation is not a supported compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve bare build behavior
recommendation.body: Remove the `help` default so bare `make` continues to build the CLI while contributors can use `make help` explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: This collaborator authored the proposed shared build-contract change and is the best available routing candidate in the supplied review context.
